hints.sandboxInfo: The test-mode for the selected payment is active. Please do not use the payment method for your order and notify the shop owner about this message.
hints.birthdayHint: You must be at least 18 years old to pay using %method%.
hints.legalText: By clicking "Submit order", you agree to the Ratepay Terms of Payment and to a risk check performed by Ratepay.
hints.legalTextSepa: By clicking "Submit order", you agree to the Ratepay Terms of Payment, including the SEPA Direct Debit mandate, and to a risk check performed by Ratepay.
hints.sepaExplanationText1: By agreeing to the SEPA Direct Debit Mandate, you authorise Ratepay GmbH to collect payments from your account by direct debit. At the same time, you instruct your bank to debit your account in accordance with the instructions from Ratepay GmbH.
hints.sepaExplanationText2: As part of your rights, you are entitled to a refund from your bank. A refund must be claimed within 8 weeks, starting from the date on which your account was debited. The terms and conditions of your bank apply.
hints.sepaExplanationText3: The mandate reference and creditor identification number will be communicated to you separately.

installment.intro: In the following you can decide how you would like to organise the payment by instalment. Simply specify the number of instalments and therefore the runtime of the instalment or simply specify the preferred number of monthly instalments.

variant1.text: Selecting %paymentMethods% will automatically send this information to %email%.

This information helps you understand the key credit terms before completing your purchase. Our payment partner Ratepay will use your email address solely to send it, using a third-party email delivery provider.
